text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel is not proof of discrimination on its own, but when paired with disparities in formal credentials (a master's degree and license versus a bachelor's) and an unreturned debrief request, unconscious bias or homophily is a plausible factor.

Whether to raise it depends on your forum. Mentioning gender composition informally to the municipality will likely provoke defensiveness and burn professional bridges without changing the outcome. However, if you pursue a formal union grievance, human rights complaint, or legal review, panel composition and qualification discrepancies become relevant context. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback. If you suspect pretext, consult an employment lawyer before escalating.
